experimental_observation.evidence_boundary: DTT supports an essential disulfide contribution but does not by itself prove tetramer stoichiometry or the chemistry of the noncovalent dimer-dimer interface.

notes: Cysteine cathepsin-like scoring emphasizes hydrophobic/aromatic P2 preference, basic P1 support, and P1' Pro penalty.
Cathepsin D/E-like scoring emphasizes hydrophobic or aromatic P1/P1' boundaries.
Scores are substrate-preference proxies and require experimental validation.
